stem.text: Red light of a single wavelength passes through a diffraction grating. Bright dots are formed on a screen, as shown.

stem.alt: Diagram of a screen containing a row of five bright dots, with the labels screen and bright dot.

stem.text: The red light is replaced with white light.
Which diagram, drawn to the same scale, shows a possible pattern of bright light on the screen?

A.alt: Rectangle containing a row of seven round dots.

B.alt: Rectangle containing a row of three round dots.

C.alt: Rectangle containing a row of five dots, the middle one round and the others elongated horizontally.

D.alt: Rectangle containing a row of five dots, the middle one round and the others elongated horizontally.
